title: Cartoon-character decor and cake
description: Decor, balloons and a cake built around the birthday child's favourite cartoon characters.

title: Kids' painting station with aprons
description: Easels, washable paints and aprons so every child paints a small canvas to take home.

title: Mini art kits as return gifts
description: Small kits with crayons, a sketch pad and stickers instead of plastic toys.

title: Character meet-and-greet
description: A performer dressed as a favourite cartoon character for photos and a short game.

title: Puppet show
description: A 30-minute puppet show with a story the children can join in.

title: Indoor games corner for rainy days
description: Musical chairs, pass-the-parcel and a puddle-free bean-bag toss set up indoors.

title: Box-cricket tournament
description: Short six-a-side box-cricket matches with a mini trophy for the winning team.

title: Science-show performer
description: A hands-on science show with safe experiments (book by category, not by name).

title: Jersey-number cake
description: A cake shaped like a sports jersey with the new age as the number.

title: Milestone photo timeline
description: A board with one photo for each month or year so far, ending with today.

title: Board-game café corner
description: A table of quick board games with a host to teach the rules.

title: Polaroid guestbook
description: Guests take an instant photo and write a wish beside it.

title: Travel-themed table names
description: Name each table after a place the guest of honour has been or wants to go.

title: Bilingual welcome boards
description: Welcome boards in both families' languages at the entrance and each function.

title: Marigold haldi decor with floral jewellery
description: Marigold strings and simple floral jewellery for the haldi, reused for photos.

title: Family performances at the sangeet
description: Short dance or song slots for each side of the family, with a running order.

title: Winter outdoor evening with heaters
description: Patio heaters and a bonfire corner keep an outdoor evening function comfortable.

title: Covered venue with waterproof decor
description: Choose a covered or tented space and fabric decor that survives rain.

title: Combined menu counters
description: One counter per family's regional favourites so both traditions share the table.

title: Dhol entry
description: A dhol team for the couple's entry and the baraat.

title: Folk musicians at dinner
description: A small folk ensemble from the region plays through dinner.

title: Photo wall by decade
description: Photos of the couple from each decade together, for guests to browse.

title: Recorded messages from grandchildren
description: Short video wishes from family who cannot travel, played after dinner.

title: Recreate the wedding menu
description: Serve the dishes from the couple's own wedding day.

title: Accessible seating and a short programme
description: Chairs with arms near the stage, ramps where needed and speeches kept short.

title: Rangoli competition by age group
description: Separate rangoli categories for kids, teens and adults, with a residents' vote.

title: Kids' rangoli workshop before the competition
description: A volunteer shows simple dot-grid rangoli patterns so younger children can enter.

title: Diya-painting stall for kids
description: Plain clay diyas and safe paints; children take their diya home.

title: Green-cracker alternative: laser show
description: A short laser or light show instead of loud fireworks, kinder to elderly residents and pets.

title: Diya decor along the walkways
description: Rows of diyas or LED diyas along paths and balconies.

title: Potluck food stalls by tradition
description: Families run small stalls of their home region's festive dishes.

title: Volunteer roster board
description: A visible roster of who runs which stall and shift, with backups.

title: Eco-friendly clay idol and tank immersion
description: A shadu-clay idol and an artificial immersion tank on the premises.

title: Aarti schedule board
description: Morning and evening aarti times with the families leading each one.

title: Flag hoisting and kids' fancy dress
description: Flag hoisting at 8 am, then a fancy-dress parade of freedom fighters.

title: Tricolour food counter
description: Saffron, white and green snacks at one counter.

title: Garba night with a dandiya workshop
description: A short workshop for beginners before the circle opens to everyone.

title: Natural colours and a water-saving play zone
description: Herbal gulal and a marked play area with buckets instead of hoses.

title: Puja items checklist and marigold toran
description: A shared checklist for the griha pravesh puja and a fresh marigold toran.

title: Plants as return gifts
description: Small potted plants for guests to take home.

title: Name-reveal board and cradle decor
description: A flower-framed board for the name reveal and a decorated cradle.

title: Kids' activity corner
description: A supervised corner with colouring, blocks and a mat, so parents can join the event.

title: Photo booth with simple props
description: A backdrop and a few props; guests take their own photos.

title: Live food counter
description: One live counter (chaat, dosa or pasta) that guests queue at, cooked fresh.
